notes.title: Man of Steal is updated to v1.0.2
notes.content:
Hi,

Man of Steal has just been updated to v1.0.2. This update only fixed a few animations. Therefore, if you already played v1.0.0 or v1.0.1, you don't need to play the game again.

After this update, future minor updates (v1.0.3, v1.0.4,...) will also improve animations to make them look better.

But if you still encounter any bugs or typos, please let me know. Thank you!

Regards!

notes.title: Man of Steal is updated to v1.0.0
notes.content:
Hi,

Man of Steal has just been updated to v1.0.0.

The game is complete now. But if there is the need to add more scenes, it will be done in the future.

And if you encounter any bugs or typos, please also let me know.

Thank you.

Regards!

notes.title: Man of Steal is updated to v0.14.0
notes.content:
Hi,

Man of Steal has just been updated to v0.14.0.

The new scenes include Rosaline (from the cross-over with My Friend's Family), Lois, Sersi & Talia. Especially, what happens with Talia in v0.14.0 will lead to her alternate endings in future releases.

If you also encounter any bugs or typos, please let me know. Thank you.

notes.title: Man of Steal is updated to v0.14-alpha
notes.content:
Hi,

Man of Steal has just been updated to v0.14-alpha. The new scenes in this release don't have text yet. And 2 animations are still being worked on. It will be updated soon.

Note: Saves seem to be broken. I don't know why, but I couldn't use previous saves when I tested it. If you also encounter this problem, I'm very sorry. Please understand. Thank you.

If you also encounter any bugs or typos, please let me know. Thank you

Regards!

notes.title: Man of Steal - v0.13.1
notes.content:
Hi,
